description_en: Queries the list of real-name registered contacts
kebab_example: aliyun alidns list-ati-change-logs --client-token eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cC..... --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --agent-id Justin@underarmour --operation-type 2074753647748672512 --operator-account 1646808646232999 --time-range '忽略' --start-timestamp 1474335170000 --end-timestamp 1474335170000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAtiChangeLogs

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The agent ID that is assigned by CNNIC after real-name verification. The AgentID serves as the unique identifier that binds the agent to the real-name registered contact
parameters.help_zh: AgentID，经过CNNIC实名认证后，由CNNIC统一分配。AgentID作为Agent与实名认证注册人绑定的唯一标识
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The operation type of the Operation logs log record, such as modifying an agent
parameters.help_zh: 操作日志记录的操作类型，比如修改Agent
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query (timestamp)
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间（时间戳）
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query (timestamp)
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间（时间戳）
parameters.name: end_timestamp
